note: Do Mi Sol goes from a bare drill (3 minutes, the cap) to a tune that skips to singing chord tones over chords, so the longer singing time is musical. The app supplies every pitch; no instrument is needed.

exercise.title: Do Mi Sol: skip, sing a tune, sing over chords
exercise.focus: Do Mi Sol in D · an easy skipping tune · Do and Sol over D and A
exercise.why: Skipping between chord notes is the first step from singing scales to singing melodies.

sections.text: Most melodies move through the notes of a chord, and Do Mi Sol is the first one.
Do Mi Sol over a drone
Press Play on the drone. Sing {{1}} {{3}} {{5}} up and back down on "la", four counts each. Then skip straight from {{1}} to {{5}} and back. Done when each note settles without sliding.
Press Play to hear the tune once, then sing it with the mic. Two clean takes, then sing it from memory without listening first.
Press Play: the chords D and A take turns, one bar each. Sing {{1}} (D) while the D chord sounds and {{5}} (A) while the A chord sounds. Then swap: {{3}} (F♯) over D, still {{5}} over A.
